objective: Understand cataract surgery, watch the 3D explanation at his own pace, then find how to book.

test: journeys\persona-a.spec.js › Persona A — older Arabic-speaking patient

steps.action: Tap the play button inside the viewer

steps.action: Check the player buttons are large enough to tap

steps.actual: mounted=false section=idle start visible=true; live WebGL contexts=1
